title: Set Up Ways to Remember
verse: Then this stone that I have set up as a sacred stone will be the house of God, and I will surely give you back a tenth of everything you give me.
observation: Jacob had an encounter with God. Afterward, he set up a way to remember this experience. Now, whenever he passed by again, he would remember what the Lord had done. He could also share his testimony with others. Then, when they passed by, they would remember the Lord’s faithfulness. We still need to do this today. We do not need to create stone pillars or memorials, but we need to write down the wonders of the Lord in our lives. Not only that, but we need to tell others what the Lord has done. This way, we can remember God’s faithfulness. Remembering His faithfulness gives us assurance that He will continue to be faithful.
application: Start a journal and write down some of the great things the Lord has done. Over time, you will be thankful for the reminders.
prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for giving us so many moments to be thankful for.
